tools.name: search_panels
tools.description: Find SMM panels in the smm.guide catalog by name or domain, market (country/language or "api"), network with a public price list, engine, verified owner. Returns summaries with Trust Score (0–100), stars, price from, order counter, age. Online panels only unless online_only is false.

tools.name: get_panel
tools.description: Every measured figure for one panel: Trust Score with its parts, stars and the platforms behind them, domain dates, price list summary per network, order counter, online status, links to the listing and the badge. Pass the slug (prm4u-com) or the domain (prm4u.com).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The public price list of a panel in US dollars per 1,000, cheapest network first. Filter by network, kind (followers, likes, views, comments, subscribers …) or a text query.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Where a service is cheapest across all panels in the catalog: offers of one network and, optionally, one kind (followers, likes, views, comments, subscribers, members, shares, live …), cheapest first, one offer per panel, in US dollars per 1,000, with the panel, its Trust Score and links. Optional f

tools.name: compare_panels
tools.description: Two to five panels side by side: Trust Score, stars and review count, price from, services, order counter, age, verified owner, online status — and the smm.guide page that compares them. Pass slugs or domains.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Tools for starting and running an SMM panel business: panel scripts (software), payment gateways, hosting, domain registrars, SMS verification, proxies, VPN and engagement platforms — each with Trust Score, reviews and a link. Filter by category and name.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: smm.guide articles: how to choose and compare SMM panels, the most popular panels, starting a panel, payment and earning guides. Optional text filter.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Country and language markets (India, Turkey, Brazil, Russia & CIS, Korea, Thailand, Indonesia, Nigeria, Vietnam, Chinese, Arabic, Spanish), "international" for panels with no local signal, and the "api" market — each with the number of panels online and the rule that puts a panel there.

tools.name: catalog_stats
tools.description: How many panels are tracked and online, verified owners, panels with an API, tools, live prices, reviews read, the review platforms.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, search_services, search_tools, catalog_stats · Public sink: search_tools · Destructive: search_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, search_services, search_tools, catalog_stats · Public sink: search_tools · Destructive: search_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
